function.name: search_flights
function.description: Search Skyway inventory for flights on one route and one date. Use it before quoting availability or fares, and to obtain the flight_id needed for a reservation. Returns matching flights sorted cheapest first; an empty list means nothing matched the filters, which is a normal outcome and not a failure.

origin.description: Departure airport as a three-letter IATA code, for example SFO. Convert city or airport names to the code before calling.

destination.description: Arrival airport as a three-letter IATA code, for example BOS.

date.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-03-05.

max_price.description: Optional upper bound on the one-way fare in US dollars. Supply it when the traveler names a budget or a price cap.

nonstop_only.description: Optional. Set to true when the traveler wants a direct flight with no layovers.

function.name: book_flight
function.description: Reserve one seat on a specific flight for one passenger. Use it after the traveler has chosen a flight and supplied the name to travel under. The response carries the confirmation number to report back, and the seat count on the flight drops by one.

flight_id.description: Flight identifier exactly as returned by search_flights, for example UA771.

passenger.description: Full name of the passenger as it should appear on the reservation.

function.name: cancel_booking
function.description: Cancel an existing reservation and release its seat back to inventory. Use it when the traveler asks to cancel and you have the booking reference. Returns an error if the reference is unknown or the reservation was already cancelled.

booking_id.description: Booking reference of the reservation to cancel, for example UPS-1001.
